हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/aWYv8k
show.description: Kismat Konnected is a high-voltage saga of passion, memory, and betrayal. Siya and Ved, two souls torn apart by tragedy and deception; spend years believing the other is dead. When fate collides once more, they meet as strangers haunted by love, their minds have erased but their hearts can’t forget. As memories ignite and buried truths surface, they must fight through lies, greed, and cruelty to reclaim each other. Because when love is eternal, even death can’t keep it apart. Watch now!
